Cc: BlueFront Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@bluefront.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor creation request + PO metadata fields

Hi Vanessa,

We need to create Redwood Inference as a supplier in our vendor system to start issuing POs. Procurement asked me to collect the following so we can onboard the vendor quickly: 

- Legal company name and DBA if any
- Tax ID / EIN and W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU)
- ACH bank details and remit-to email (or voided check)
- Preferred invoice format (PDF + line-item CSV)
- Required PO metadata: PO number placement, invoice reference fields, and if you can put the bluefront PO number in the invoice header vs. line-level
- Any EDI/Peppol connector preference (we use EDI now, but portal upload is fine)

Also, what is your standard invoice cutoff for month-end processing? Procurement needs to confirm whether split-invoice is supported for multi-entity POs (we sometimes split payments across GLs).

If you can send an AP onboarding packet (or confirm the fields above), I will route to Procurement and get a supplier portal invite out.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Sr. Procurement Manager
BlueFront Inc.

Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor creation request + PO metadata fields

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can get this through quickly. Quick answers up front and a couple of asks so we provision correctly: 

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (DBA: Redwood Inference)
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached in my follow-up)
- Bank: ACH preferred; we will attach a remittance email and an ACH form in the packet
- Invoice format: PDF invoice + single CSV attachment accepted. We can also send e-invoice via Peppol if you prefer (we support both)
- PO metadata: we require the customer PO number in the invoice header (Invoice Reference / PO number field) for automated matching. Line-level PO references are optional. If you include an extra field called "buyer_reference" in your portal CSV, that maps cleanly to our AP system.
- Cutoff: our friendly month-end cutoff is receipts by 5pm PT on the last business day for inclusion in that month; we can support earlier/specific cutoffs if required.
- Split-invoice: supported (we can produce multiple invoices per PO with GL allocations) — include split instructions in the PO lines or in the PO attachment.

Can you: (1) issue a supplier portal invite or share the portal CSV template, and (2) confirm whether Procurement wants a vendor master created under BlueFront legal entity A vs entity B (this affects remit instructions).

I'll assemble and send our AP onboarding packet and W-9 by tomorrow. Looping in Rishi and Laura for billing/accounting confirmation.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Billing & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — attaching the packet I keep for supplier onboarding. Key points for BlueFront: 

- Packet contents: W-9 (US), Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf (banking + ACH form), remittance contact, example invoice, sample CSV mapping for portal.
- Portal CSV mapping: include columns: supplier_legal_name, supplier_tax_id, remit_email, bank_ach_routing, bank_ach_account, invoice_reference (PO), line_item_reference (optional), buyer_reference (optional), currency, invoice_date, total_amount. We prefer PO in invoice_reference for automated match.
- EDI/Peppol: we support Peppol e-invoicing; if Procurement wants EDI we need their standard 850/810 mapping file (we can map).
- For split invoicing: request PO be tagged with "split_billing:true" and provide GL splits in an attached CSV.

I'll attach the packet here. Marcus — can you confirm the bank name and the ACH remit email in the packet header before I send?

Thanks,

Hi Elena — attaching our formal AP onboarding packet and W-9 per your request. Highlights below to help Procurement map fields quickly: 

- Required invoice field: "Invoice Reference" = BlueFront PO number (exact match required for automated matching). If the PO number appears only on the PO attachment, please also populate "Invoice Reference" in the portal CSV.
- Line items: if you want split payments, include a CSV column "split_instructions" with JSON-style mapping (example in packet).
- Remit-to: payments@redwood.com (for remittance advices). ACH details are on page 3 of the packet.
- Cutoff: invoices received by 17:00 PT on the last business day are included in the month run. If Procurement needs a different schedule, let us know and we can accommodate via an agreed SLA.
- Portal invite: please use the supplier portal invite link or, if you prefer, send the CSV back to accounts-payable@redwood.com and we'll confirm.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf, W-9_RedwoodInc.pdf

Action items for Procurement: 
1) Confirm legal entity (BlueFront A or B) to host the supplier master.
2) Issue portal invite or return filled CSV template.
3) Confirm whether Peppol e-invoicing is preferred.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if it helps get this live faster.

Best,

Hi Elena — quick answers: 

- Invoice placement: PO number in the invoice metadata (Invoice Reference field) is sufficient for our systems. However, including the PO number as a visible header on the PDF (top-right or top-left) speeds manual review if Procurement does any human checks. So either is fine — metadata required for automated match, visible header recommended.
- Cutoff timezone: 17:00 PT means Pacific Time (PST/PDT). For clarity: during DST it is PDT — we follow the local Pacific time definition used by our finance team.

Thanks — we'll watch for the portal invite and will confirm once the supplier record is active.

Best,
Vanessa
Head of Customer Billing & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
